items.title: Unkernel: 실제 Linux 커널을 WebAssembly로 컴파일
items.summary: 실제 Linux 커널을 WebAssembly로 컴파일해 브라우저 탭에서 실행 함. Debian과 Alpine의 ARM64 패키지도 apt 나 apk 로 설치해 그대로 쓸 수 있음 Debian, Alpine 또는 기본 셸로 부팅할 수 있고, 루트 파일 시스템의 변경 사항은 배포판별로 브라우저에 보관함 ARM64 프로그램은 에뮬레이션 하고, 자주 실행되는 코드는 JIT로 WebAssembly로 변환해 속도를 높임. CPU를 여러 개 설정하면 각각 별도의 Web Worker에서 실행됨 Wisp 네트워크 로 게스트의 인터넷 연결을 제공하고, 게스트에서 실행한 웹 서버를 브라우저 창이나 별도 탭으로 열 …

items.title: Binance Fully Lifts Withdrawal Suspension a Month After $6.3 Billion Hack
items.summary: Bitcoin Magazine Binance Fully Lifts Withdrawal Suspension a Month After $6.3 Billion Hack Binance said its withdrawal recovery work is complete and the suspension tied to the Oct. 29 hack has been fully lifted, as researchers track North Korean launderers moving the stolen funds. This post Binance Fully Lifts Withdrawal Suspension a Month After $6.3 Billion Hack first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
items.content: Bitcoin Magazine Binance Fully Lifts Withdrawal Suspension a Month After $6.3 Billion Hack Binance has fully lifted the withdrawal suspension it put in place after last month’s record $6.3 billion hack, saying its recovery work is complete and that withdrawals are open across nearly all networks. “Our withdrawal recovery work is completed and the withdrawal suspension from the security incident has been fully lifted,” the exchange said in an X post Thursday afternoon.
items.author: Micah Zimmerman

items.title: Russia’s VTB Opens Bitcoin Trading as Central Bank Finalizes Crypto Test
items.summary: Bitcoin Magazine Russia’s VTB Opens Bitcoin Trading as Central Bank Finalizes Crypto Test VTB began letting qualified investors trade bitcoin in its app on Friday, a day after the Bank of Russia approved the knowledge test every crypto buyer must pass. SPB Exchange plans to open spot trading Dec. 1. This post Russia’s VTB Opens Bitcoin Trading as Central Bank Finalizes Crypto Test first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
items.content: Bitcoin Magazine Russia’s VTB Opens Bitcoin Trading as Central Bank Finalizes Crypto Test Russian bank VTB began letting brokerage clients buy and sell bitcoin in its investing app on Friday, a day after the Bank of Russia approved the knowledge test every Russian crypto buyer now has to pass. Starting Nov. 27, clients of VTB’s brokerage can trade cryptocurrencies in the VTB My Investments app, the broker said .

items.content: Bitcoin Magazine New York Wins $1.37 Billion Judgment Against NovaTech Crypto Ponzi Founders A New York judge has ordered the founders of NovaTech, a cryptocurrency investment scheme that targeted Haitian communities, to pay more than $1.37 billion, closing out the state’s case against a couple who fled the country rather than answer it. Justice Anar Rathod Patel of the New York County Supreme Court signed the order on Nov. 24.
